verdict.rationale: Spline documents a JavaScript Code API, but the evidence explicitly says there is no hosted reference or runner and no machine-readable spec, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. The editor's Real-time API Response preview and live webhook URL are in-editor conveniences, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
